name: odoo-devtools-vscode
description: All-in-one VS Code extension for managing Odoo projects, databases, modules, and debugging.

commands.title: Run Odoo Tests for Current File

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a folder or a workspace for the extension to work.
[Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)
[Open Workspace](command:workbench.action.openWorkspace)

No projects yet. A project groups your repositories, databases and settings.
[Create Project](command:projectSelector.create)

No databases to show. Select a project, then create or link a database.
[Create Database](command:dbSelector.create)

No repositories found. Repositories are discovered in the active version's custom addons folder.
[Manage Versions](command:odoo.manageVersions)

Select a project and a database to see and manage their modules.
[Switch Database](command:dbSelector.quickSearch)
Select a project and a database to configure test runs.

No versions yet. A version stores the paths, port and defaults for one Odoo setup.
[Create Version](command:odoo.createVersion)

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.debuggerName.description: Default debugger name for new versions

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.debuggerVers.description: Default debugger version for new versions

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.portNumber.description: Default port number for new versions

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.shellPortNum.description: Default shell port number for new versions

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.limitTimeRea.description: Default real time limit for new versions (0 = unlimited)

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.limitTimeCpu.description: Default CPU time limit for new versions (0 = unlimited)

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.maxCronThrea.description: Default maximum cron threads for new versions (0 = unlimited)

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.extraParams.description: Default extra parameters for new versions

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.devMode.description: Default development mode for new versions

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.dumpsFolder.description: Default dumps folder path for new versions

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.odooPath.description: Default Odoo installation path for new versions

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.enterprisePa.description: Default enterprise addons path for new versions

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.designThemes.description: Default design themes path for new versions

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.customAddons.description: Default custom addons path for new versions

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.pythonPath.description: Default Python executable path for new versions

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.subModulesPa.description: Default sub-modules paths for new versions

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.installApps.description: Extra apps appended to -i in addition to the Modules view selections (comma-separated). The Modules view is the primary way to select modules.

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.upgradeApps.description: Extra apps appended to -u in addition to the Modules view selections (comma-separated). The Modules view is the primary way to select modules.

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.preCheckoutC.markdownDescription: Commands to run before switching branches when using this version. Each entry runs in a shell; use workspace-absolute paths if needed.

odooDebugger.defaultVersion.postCheckout.markdownDescription: Commands to run after switching branches when using this version. Each entry runs in a shell; use workspace-absolute paths if needed.

odooDebugger.ticketBaseUrl.description: Base URL used when opening project tickets. Ticket links are built as <base>/odoo/all-tasks/<ticket_id>.

enumDescriptions: Automatically align the active version and git branches when selecting a database
Show a notification asking whether to align when selecting a database
Never switch versions or branches automatically
odooDebugger.databaseSwitchBehavior.description: What happens to the active version and git branches when you select a database. Legacy values (auto-both, auto-version-only, auto-branch-only) are migrated to "auto".

odooDebugger.search.maxDepth.description: Maximum folder depth to scan when discovering modules and repositories.

odooDebugger.search.maxEntries.description: Upper limit on the number of directories inspected during recursive discovery.

odooDebugger.search.excludePatterns.modu.description: Glob patterns to skip while searching for Odoo modules.

odooDebugger.search.excludePatterns.repo.description: Glob patterns to skip while searching for Git repositories.

odooDebugger.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the active project, database and version in the status bar (click to switch).

odooDebugger.server.openBrowserOnStart.description: After starting the Odoo server, open the web client in the browser once the server port accepts connections.

odooDebugger.editorActions.enabled.description: Show Odoo actions (Run Tests for Current File, Upgrade Current Module, Reveal Module) in the editor right-click menu.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Odoo DevTools
walkthroughs.description: Set up your Odoo development workbench: defaults, a version profile, a project with its database, and the debugger.

steps.title: Configure default paths
steps.description:
Point the extension at your Odoo repositories, Python environment and dumps folder.
[Open Settings](command:odoo.openVersionDefaults)

steps.title: Create a version profile
steps.description:
Pick an Odoo branch and name the profile - two prompts, done.
[Create Version](command:odoo.createVersion)

steps.title: Create a project
steps.description:
Group your repositories and set up a database (fresh, dump, template or existing).
[Create Project](command:projectSelector.create)

steps.title: Select modules & start debugging
steps.description:
Mark modules for install/upgrade and launch Odoo under the debugger.
[Start Server](command:odoo.startServer)

steps.title: Testing mode, templates & shortcuts
steps.description: Database switching, testing mode, DB templates, the status bar and keybindings.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
